title: Estonia's Minority Government Navigates Political Fragility Amid Uneven… · 15 Aug
keywords: Estonia, Riigikogu, minority government, coalition collapse, Estonian economy, GDP growth, unemployment, inflation, European Union, fiscal policy, Baltic states, political instability, economic recovery
notes: Estonia's ruling coalition has lost its parliamentary majority after two MPs defected, leaving the government to manage day-to-day affairs with exactly half of the Riigikogu's 101 seats. The political turbulence coincides with a mixed economic picture: GDP is growing again, but unemployment remains elevated and households have yet to feel a broad-based recovery. Together, the two developments pose a significant test for one of the European Union's smallest but most closely watched member states.
